title: 40K ⭐ 1-BIT LLMs ON YOUR CPU
description:
Microsoft BitNet is an open source framework for running one-bit language models.

https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet

BitNet reduces memory and power needs, so experimenting with large models does not always require an expensive GPU.

The link is in the description.
